LanguageData.BM_DeployShieldProjector.label: deploy shield projector
LanguageData.BM_DeployShieldProjector.description: Deploy a portable shield projector. The projector creates a momentum-repulsor field that intercepts enemy projectiles for a limited time.\n\nHas 3 charges. Can be reloaded by consuming a shield core (right-click to reload).
LanguageData.BM_DeployHealingSmokeGenerator.label: deploy healing smoke generator
LanguageData.BM_DeployHealingSmokeGenerator.descripti: Deploy a healing smoke generator. The generator continuously tends wounds and heals anyone within its radius for 30 seconds.\n\nHas 3 charges. Can be reloaded by consuming glitterworld medicine (right-click to reload).
